scope: Secondary terminal evaluation of frozen joint OOF predictions after joint MSE inspection. Identification rules were fixed in the earlier specificity analysis; no model refitting or test-based gene selection.

inherited_rules.similarity: Pearson across all genes after subtracting outer-training human mean for the same time/nominal-dose stratum; unseen strata use global training human mean.
inherited_rules.candidate_pool: Unique compounds in the same outer-test fold and time/nominal-dose stratum, including the correct compound. Duplicate compound-stratum rows are rejected before fitting.
inherited_rules.chance: Per query: top1=1/K, rank=(K+1)/2, MRR=harmonic(K)/K; then rows within compound and compounds equally.
inherited_rules.ties: Absolute score tolerance 1e-10; uniform ordering in the true-score tie. Top1 fractional if tied for first; rank is mean tied rank; MRR is mean reciprocal of tied positions.
inherited_rules.undefined: Fewer than 2 candidates, candidate centred norm <=1e-12, or query centred norm <=1e-12 remains missing with reasons. Undefined candidate keeps its whole pool undefined, without shrinking K.
inherited_rules.comparability: Report each model's coverage and a common-defined query set for the four learned models. Zero response and training human context mean are separate references.

model_intersection: Common-defined queries for the two frozen joint procedures; report each model's full coverage separately.
candidate_exposure_scope: Candidates share outer fold and nominal time/dose level. Their planned absolute rat and human concentrations can differ; this is not a candidate pool matched for full exposure context. The training human context mean uses these same nominal strata.
human_context_mean: For each outer test fold, row-weighted human mean by time/nominal-dose from all other folds, with global training mean fallback. Store float32 then score float64, matching the earlier scorer's convention.
gene_axis: Every supplied human target gene, unchanged; no test-based selection or weighting.
limitations: Known candidate human profiles enter terminal scoring; this is not identification without human candidate measurements.
Chance is calculated from each query's K before compound averaging; per-query candidates are dependent.
These descriptive retrieval metrics do not identify unique biological mechanisms or establish prospective validation.
